_comment: Sibling of layout/pex/pex.json, over layout/ro_ring5*/ instead of the
nine leaf cells -- extracts each fully-composed, DRC-clean and
LVS-clean ring GDS (real inter-gate metal routing, not the ideal wires
layout/pex/ro_ring5_pex.spice's leaf-cell composition assumes between
gates) with `klt extract --parasitics`, and rewrites the result the
same way: `layout/bin/pex-netlist.py` is shared, unmodified, between
both descriptors. See layout/README.md's 'Newly possible, not yet
done' note (issue #22/#27 step 5) for why this is a separate library
rather than a rewrite of layout/pex/ro_ring5_pex.spice -- the two
measure different things (per-gate composition with ideal inter-gate
wires vs. one flat ring extraction with real inter-gate wires) and
swapping the netlist under sim/post-layout-ro-ring5/'s existing
records would make them incomparable with what they were measured
against.
Same field contract as layout/pex/pex.json -- see that file's own
_comment block. cells[].ports is design/ro_array_core.spice's own
`.subckt ro_ring5 en ro vddr vss` port order; n1-n4 and py are
internal-to-the-ring nets the two-pass leaf composition promoted to
physical pins (see layout/README.md), kept local by pex-netlist.py's
wrapper the same way ro_stage/ro_nand2's own ny/py already are in
layout/pex/pex.json. ro_buf_pex is duplicated here (same GDS as
layout/pex/pex.json's own ro_buf_pex entry) so this library is
self-contained for a testbench that .includes only @@PEX_LIB@@ plus
design/ro_ring5.spice -- avoiding a same-subckt-name collision from
.include-ing both pex libraries in one deck.
